author: The Infographics Show
description:
The Trillion Dollar AI Lie is already reshaping the global economy.
OpenAI, NVIDIA, Big Tech, and corporate CEOs are burning through hundreds of billions chasing an AI future that still may not be profitable.

Behind every AI chatbot and generative AI tool is a massive physical system.
Data centers consume enormous amounts of electricity, power grids are pushed to their limits, and water supplies are being drained while low paid human workers quietly correct AI mistakes behind the scenes.

Meanwhile, corporations are flooding AI systems with sensitive company data, source code, contracts, and private information, creating what some researchers are calling the largest uncontrolled corporate data leak in history.

Despite all the hype, most AI projects still fail to deliver meaningful profits. CEOs continue pouring money into GPUs, semiconductors, OpenAI partnerships, and AI infrastructure because nobody wants to be left behind in the AI arms race.

But cracks are starting to appear.

title: The Trillion Dollar AI Lie. CEOs Are Bleeding BILLIONS.
